title: PUT /v1/device/contexts/{object}/chunks/{index} request
description: Body of PUT /v1/device/contexts/{object}/chunks/{index} (03-api.md section 6.1, ADR-072 section 5): one sealed chunk of a context checkpoint or a log of the session (nonce || AES-GCM, at most 2 MiB + 28 bytes).

kind.description: kind of the object, read with its first chunk (absent: context); a log is the output of a test run or a work VM job (ADR-080 section 3)
